questions.stem: A 35-year-old patient is diagnosed with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD). Genetic testing reveals a mutation in the PKD1 gene. Which of the following mechanisms is most likely involved in the formation of renal cysts in this patient?

options.label: B
options.text: Dysfunction of polycystin proteins on the primary cilium

options.label: C
options.text: Overactivation of chloride and aquaporin channels

options.label: D
options.text: Decreased proliferation of renal epithelial cells and increased fluid secretion
